reason: A browser-based frontend verification plugin that helps agents inspect pages, detect console and network issues, exercise interfaces, validate rendered layout facts, and capture screenshots during a self-check loop.

summaries.zh: 用于前端验证的浏览器工具插件，可帮助智能体打开页面、检查控制台与网络请求、读取布局信息、操作界面并保存截图。
summaries.en: A browser-based frontend verification plugin that lets agents inspect pages, check console and network issues, validate layout facts, interact with interfaces, and save screenshots.

capabilities: Opens local files, local directories, and permitted HTTP(S) URLs in Chromium
Reads rendered text, HTML, bounding boxes, and computed styles
Captures console messages and failed network requests
Interacts with page elements through clicks, typing, key presses, and scrolling
Saves viewport, full-page, or element screenshots to the workspace
